$comment: Story 4.3e (ADR-156): from the dark Palace ring to the Lalbagh glass house, the last base.

panels.title: THE PALACE · 06:30
panels.text: The truck that left in the night doesn't come back.

panels.title: LALBAGH WEST GATE · 09:10
panels.text: Rock, lawns, the old bandstand. Nothing moves but the crows.

panels.title: THE GLASS HOUSE · 09:40
panels.text: Iron, glass, planks across the doors, and inside, a purple glow.
